parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, md.max_phase, di.mesh_heading, md.first_approval FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno JOIN drug_indication di ON di.molregno = md.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 ORDER BY md.first_approval DESC
